title: The present convergence is primarily institutional transparency activity
description: The strongest common thread is policy, reporting, and record release—not a demonstrated common physical cause.
would_change: New primary records with independently verifiable sensor data tied to specific incidents.

title: The sources describe one coordinated non-human disclosure event
description: The reviewed materials do not establish that historical incidents, modern testimony, and current releases share one cause.
would_change: Authenticated records that explicitly connect the incidents and survive independent technical review.
